why: GA put 3.0.0 on latest; basalt-ui-obsidian still pins an exact 3.0.0-next.N. A stalled prerelease pin is how a consumer silently rots (rollhook sat on a dead pin for 19 minors).

exemplar: The repo's own previous bump commit (`git log --oneline -- bun.lock | head`) for message shape.
